title: coleus cylindraceus
intro: Coleus cylindraceus, commonly known as Blue Pilea, is a flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Coleus cylindraceus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
